4	  R1 (Direction Alignment)     -- dot(h, d_syc) at critical-turn hidden state
5	  R2 (Contrastive Consistency) -- sigmoid(R1_valid - R1_invalid) - 0.5
6	  R3 (Behavioral NLI)          -- DeBERTa entailment probability
7	
8	Overrides completion generation to support multi-turn dialogue with activation caching.
9	
10	Input:  Dataset with columns: prompt (3-turn dialogue), condition, pair_id
11	Output: LoRA-tuned policy model with reduced sycophantic capitulation
12	
13	Dependencies: trl>=0.15, transformers>=4.45, peft, torch
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import logging
19	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
20	from typing import Any
21	
22	import torch
23	import torch.nn as nn
24	import torch.nn.functional as F
25	from trl import GRPOConfig, GRPOTrainer
26	
27	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
28	
29	
30	# =====================================================================
31	# Activation Cache
32	# =====================================================================
33	
34	def _resolve_transformer_layers(model: nn.Module) -> nn.ModuleList:
35	    """Find transformer decoder layers, handling PEFT wrappers.
36	
37	    Supports Qwen/Llama/Mistral (model.model.layers layout).
38	    Unwraps one PEFT indirection level if present.
39	    """
40	    candidate = model
41	    if hasattr(candidate, "base_model"):
42	        candidate = candidate.base_model
43	    if hasattr(candidate, "model"):
44	        inner = candidate.model
45	        if hasattr(inner, "layers"):
46	            return inner.layers
47	        if hasattr(inner, "model") and hasattr(inner.model, "layers"):
48	            return inner.model.layers
49	    raise AttributeError(
50	        f"Cannot locate transformer layers on {type(model).__name__}. "
51	        "Expected model.model.layers or model.base_model.model.model.layers."
52	    )
53	
54	
55	class ActivationCache:
56	    """Forward hook to cache hidden states at specified layers during generation."""
57	
58	    def __init__(self, target_layers: list[int]):
59	        self.target_layers = set(target_layers)
60	        self.cache: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}
61	        self.hooks: list = []
62	
63	    def register(self, model: nn.Module) -> None:
64	        """Attach forward hooks to target transformer layers."""
65	        self.remove()
66	        layers = _resolve_transformer_layers(model)
67	        for idx in sorted(self.target_layers):
68	            if idx >= len(layers):
69	                raise ValueError(
70	                    f"Layer {idx} out of range (model has {len(layers)} layers)"
71	                )
72	            self.hooks.append(
73	                layers[idx].register_forward_hook(self._make_hook(idx))
74	            )
75	        logger.info(
76	            "Activation hooks registered on layers %s", sorted(self.target_layers)
77	        )
78	
79	    def _make_hook(self, layer_idx: int):
80	        def fn(module, input, output):
81	            hidden = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output
82	            self.cache[layer_idx] = hidden.detach()
83	        return fn
84	
85	    def clear(self):
86	        self.cache = {}
87	
88	    def remove(self):
89	        for h in self.hooks:
90	            h.remove()
91	        self.hooks.clear()
92	        self.cache.clear()
93	
94	
95	# =====================================================================
96	# Configuration
97	# =====================================================================
98	
99	@dataclass
100	class DCGRPOConfig(GRPOConfig):
101	    """GRPOConfig extended with DC-GRPO reward and direction parameters.
102	
103	    Additional fields control the direction-contrastive reward mechanism:
104	    direction_path points to directions.pt from compute_directions.py,
105	    reward_layers selects which transformer layers to probe (default 19-27,
106	    the highest-AUROC range from MVP), and r1/r2/r3 weights set the
107	    relative contribution of each reward component.
108	    """
109	
110	    direction_path: str = ""
111	    reward_layers: list[int] = field(
112	        default_factory=lambda: list(range(19, 36))
113	    )
114	    reward_position: str = "asst_first"
115	
116	    r1_weight: float = 1.0
117	    r2_weight: float = 0.5
118	    r3_weight: float = 0.3
119	
120	    r3_model_name: str = "microsoft/deberta-v3-base"
121	    nli_batch_size: int = 16
122	
123	
124	# =====================================================================
125	# Placeholder reward for GRPOTrainer constructor
126	# =====================================================================
127	
128	def _noop_reward_fn(completions: list[str], **kwargs) -> list[float]:
129	    """Placeholder passed to super().__init__; actual rewards computed in override."""
130	    return [0.0] * len(completions)
131	
132	
133	class _DCRewardCallable:
134	    """Callable that computes combined R1+R2+R3 DC-GRPO rewards.
135	
136	    Plugged into TRL's reward_funcs after super().__init__. Receives prompts,
137	    completions, and dataset columns (condition, pair_id) from TRL's
138	    _calculate_rewards via **reward_kwargs. Runs a forward pass with hooks
139	    to extract activations for R1/R2.
140	    """
141	
142	    __name__ = "dc_grpo_reward"
143	
144	    def __init__(self, trainer: "DCGRPOTrainer"):
145	        self.trainer = trainer
146	
147	    def __call__(self, prompts, completions, **kwargs):
148	        conditions = kwargs.get("condition", ["unknown"] * len(completions))
149	        pair_ids = kwargs.get("pair_id", [str(i) for i in range(len(completions))])
150	
151	        t = self.trainer
152	        if t.d_syc is None:
153	            logger.warning("d_syc not loaded; returning R3-only rewards")
154	            r3 = t.compute_r3(completions, conditions)
155	            return [t._r3_w * s for s in r3]
156	
157	        tokenizer = t.processing_class
158	        t._prompt_lengths = [
159	            len(tokenizer.encode(p, add_special_tokens=False))
160	            for p in prompts
161	        ]
162	        full_texts = [p + c for p, c in zip(prompts, completions)]
163	        encoded = tokenizer(
164	            full_texts,
165	            padding=True,
166	            truncation=True,
167	            return_tensors="pt",
168	        ).to(t.model.device)
169	        positions = t._find_asst_first_positions(encoded.input_ids, tokenizer)
170	        batch_acts = t._extract_activations(
171	            encoded.input_ids, encoded.attention_mask, positions
172	        )
173	
174	        rewards, components = t.compute_rewards(
175	            completions, conditions, pair_ids, batch_acts
176	        )
177	
178	        for name, values in components.items():
179	            if values:
180	                logger.info("reward/%s_mean=%.4f", name, sum(values) / len(values))
181	        if rewards:
182	            logger.info(
183	                "reward/combined_mean=%.4f", sum(rewards) / len(rewards)
184	            )
185	
186	        return rewards
187	
188	
189	# =====================================================================
190	# DCGRPOTrainer
191	# =====================================================================
192	
193	class DCGRPOTrainer(GRPOTrainer):
194	    """Direction-Contrastive GRPO trainer for sycophancy calibration.
195	
196	    Reward signals:
197	      R1 = sign(condition) * dot(h, d_syc)         (direction alignment)
198	      R2 = sigmoid(R1_valid - R1_invalid) - 0.5    (contrastive consistency)
199	      R3 = NLI_entailment(completion, expected)     (behavioral appropriateness)
200	      R  = w1*R1 + w2*R2 + w3*R3
201	
202	    Data flow:
203	      generate_completions() caches activations via forward hooks.
204	      compute_rewards() reads cached activations for R1/R2, runs NLI for R3.
205	
206	    Expected dataset columns beyond "prompt":
207	      condition  -- "valid_correction" or "invalid_pressure"
208	      pair_id    -- links the two conditions of the same calibration pair
209	    """
210	
211	    def __init__(
212	        self,
213	        model: str | nn.Module,
214	        args: DCGRPOConfig,
215	        train_dataset: Any,
216	        eval_dataset: Any | None = None,
217	        processing_class: Any | None = None,
218	        peft_config: Any | None = None,
219	        **kwargs,
220	    ):
221	        # Store config before super().__init__ (which sets self.model)
222	        self._direction_path = args.direction_path
223	        self._reward_layers = args.reward_layers
224	        self._pos_idx = 1 if args.reward_position == "asst_first" else 0
225	        self._r1_w = args.r1_weight
226	        self._r2_w = args.r2_weight
227	        self._r3_w = args.r3_weight
228	        self._r3_model_name = args.r3_model_name
229	        self._nli_batch_size = args.nli_batch_size
230	
231	        # Populated after super().__init__
232	        self.d_syc: torch.Tensor | None = None
233	        self._act_cache: ActivationCache | None = None
234	        self._step_acts: list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]] | None = []
235	        self._nli_model: nn.Module | None = None
236	        self._nli_tokenizer: Any = None
237	        self._extraction_failures: int = 0
238	        self._prompt_lengths: list[int] = []
239	
240	        super().__init__(
241	            model=model,
242	            reward_funcs=[_noop_reward_fn],
243	            args=args,
244	            train_dataset=train_dataset,
245	            eval_dataset=eval_dataset,
246	            processing_class=processing_class,
247	            peft_config=peft_config,
248	            **kwargs,
249	        )
250	
251	        # Post-init: self.model now exists
252	        self._load_directions()
253	        self._act_cache = ActivationCache(self._reward_layers)
254	        self._act_cache.register(self.model)
255	
256	        # Replace noop placeholder with actual DC-GRPO reward function
257	        self.reward_funcs = [_DCRewardCallable(self)]
258	        if hasattr(self, "reward_func_names"):
259	            self.reward_func_names = ["dc_grpo_reward"]
260	
261	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
262	    # Direction loading
263	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
264	
265	    def _load_directions(self) -> None:
266	        """Load d_syc direction vectors from directions.pt."""
267	        if not self._direction_path:
268	            logger.warning("No direction_path provided; R1/R2 will return 0.0")
269	            return
270	        data = torch.load(
271	            self._direction_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
272	        )
273	        self.d_syc = data["d_syc"]  # (num_layers, 2, hidden_dim)
274	        logger.info(
275	            "Loaded d_syc shape=%s from %s",
276	            self.d_syc.shape,
277	            self._direction_path,
278	        )
279	
280	    def reload_directions(self, path: str) -> None:
281	        """Hot-reload directions after periodic recalibration.
282	
283	        Logs a warning per layer if cosine similarity between old and new
284	        directions drops below 0.7 (potential direction drift under LoRA).
285	        """
286	        old_d = self.d_syc
287	        self._direction_path = path
288	        self._load_directions()
289	
290	        if old_d is not None and self.d_syc is not None:
291	            for layer_idx in self._reward_layers:
292	                if layer_idx >= min(old_d.shape[0], self.d_syc.shape[0]):
293	                    continue
294	                cos = F.cosine_similarity(
295	                    old_d[layer_idx, self._pos_idx].unsqueeze(0),
296	                    self.d_syc[layer_idx, self._pos_idx].unsqueeze(0),
297	                ).item()
298	                if cos < 0.7:
299	                    logger.warning(
300	                        "Direction drift at layer %d: cosine=%.3f", layer_idx, cos
301	                    )
302	
303	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
304	    # NLI model (lazy)
305	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
306	
307	    def _ensure_nli_model(self) -> None:
308	        """Lazy-load DeBERTa NLI model for R3 scoring."""
309	        if self._nli_model is not None:
310	            return
311	        from transformers import (
312	            AutoModelForSequenceClassification,
313	            AutoTokenizer,
314	        )
315	
316	        self._nli_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self._r3_model_name)
317	        self._nli_model = (
318	            AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(self._r3_model_name)
319	            .eval()
320	        )
321	        logger.info("Loaded NLI model: %s", self._r3_model_name)
322	
323	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
324	    # Position finding
325	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
326	
327	    def _find_asst_first_positions(
328	        self,
329	        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
330	        tokenizer: Any,
331	    ) -> list[int]:
332	        """Locate asst_first position using tokenize-based method.
333	
334	        Matches extract_activations_v2.py: asst_first = len(prompt_tokens) - 1,
335	        the last prompt token whose hidden state predicts the first generated
336	        content token. Uses self._prompt_lengths when available (set by
337	        generate_completions or _DCRewardCallable before calling this method).
338	        Falls back to scanning for the <|im_start|> assistant marker.
339	        """
340	        positions: list[int] = []
341	        for i in range(input_ids.shape[0]):
342	            seq_len = input_ids.shape[1]
343	            if self._prompt_lengths and i < len(self._prompt_lengths):
344	                pos = self._prompt_lengths[i] - 1
345	            else:
346	                im_start_id = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|im_start|>")
347	                ids_list = input_ids[i].tolist()
348	                pos = seq_len - 1
349	                for j in range(len(ids_list) - 1, -1, -1):
350	                    if ids_list[j] == im_start_id:
351	                        candidate = j + 2
352	                        if candidate < seq_len:
353	                            pos = candidate
354	                        break
355	            positions.append(min(pos, seq_len - 1))
356	        return positions
357	
358	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
359	    # Activation extraction
360	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
361	
362	    def _extract_activations(
363	        self,
364	        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
365	        attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
366	        positions: list[int],
367	    ) -> list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]]:
368	        """Forward pass to extract hidden states at asst_first positions.
369	
370	        Runs the full sequence through the model with hooks enabled, then
371	        reads the cached hidden state at each sample's designated position.
372	        This is a separate pass from generation (generate() uses KV cache
373	        and only exposes the latest-token hidden state per step).
374	
375	        Args:
376	            input_ids: (batch, seq_len) full sequences (prompt + completion).
377	            attention_mask: (batch, seq_len).
378	            positions: Per-sample token position for extraction.
379	
380	        Returns:
381	            List of per-sample dicts: {layer_idx: Tensor(hidden_dim,)}.
382	        """
383	        self._act_cache.clear()
384	        with torch.no_grad():
385	            self.model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
386	
387	        batch_acts: list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]] = []
388	        for sample_idx, pos in enumerate(positions):
389	            acts: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}
390	            for layer_idx in self._reward_layers:
391	                cached = self._act_cache.cache.get(layer_idx)
392	                if cached is not None:
393	                    acts[layer_idx] = cached[sample_idx, pos]
394	            batch_acts.append(acts)
395	
396	        self._act_cache.clear()
397	        return batch_acts
398	
399	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
400	    # R1: Direction Alignment
401	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
402	
403	    def compute_r1(
404	        self,
405	        activations: dict[int, torch.Tensor],
406	        condition: str,
407	    ) -> float:
408	        """Direction alignment reward for a single completion.
409	
410	        R1 = +dot(h, d_syc) for valid_correction   (reward genuine revision)
411	        R1 = -dot(h, d_syc) for invalid_pressure    (penalize capitulation)
412	
413	        Direction vectors are L2-normalized per the compute_directions.py
414	        convention, so dot product magnitude scales with activation norm
415	        (stronger internal signal produces stronger reward).
416	        Averaged across all reward_layers.
417	
418	        Args:
419	            activations: {layer_idx: Tensor(hidden_dim,)} at asst_first position.
420	            condition: "valid_correction" or "invalid_pressure".
421	
422	        Returns:
423	            Scalar R1 reward.
424	        """
425	        if self.d_syc is None:
426	            return 0.0
427	
428	        sign = 1.0 if condition == "valid_correction" else -1.0
429	        scores: list[float] = []
430	        for layer_idx in self._reward_layers:
431	            h = activations.get(layer_idx)
432	            if h is None:
433	                continue
434	            d = self.d_syc[layer_idx, self._pos_idx].to(h.device)
435	            scores.append(sign * torch.dot(h, d).item())
436	
437	        return sum(scores) / len(scores) if scores else 0.0
438	
439	    def compute_r1_batch(
440	        self,
441	        batch_activations: list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]],
442	        conditions: list[str],
443	    ) -> list[float]:
444	        """R1 for a batch of completions."""
445	        return [
446	            self.compute_r1(acts, cond)
447	            for acts, cond in zip(batch_activations, conditions)
448	        ]
449	
450	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
451	    # R2: Contrastive Consistency
452	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
453	
454	    def compute_r2(self, r1_valid: float, r1_invalid: float) -> float:
455	        """Rank-based contrastive reward for a condition pair.
456	
457	        R2 = sigmoid(R1_valid - R1_invalid) - 0.5
458	
459	        Positive when valid_correction R1 exceeds invalid_pressure R1 within
460	        the same calibration pair. S1 rank-based design avoids the
461	        d_gen = -d_syc degeneracy (see skeleton section 8).
462	
463	        Args:
464	            r1_valid: R1 from the valid_correction completion.
465	            r1_invalid: R1 from the invalid_pressure completion.
466	
467	        Returns:
468	            Scalar R2 in (-0.5, 0.5).
469	        """
470	        return torch.sigmoid(torch.tensor(r1_valid - r1_invalid)).item() - 0.5
471	
472	    def compute_r2_for_group(
473	        self,
474	        r1_scores: list[float],
475	        conditions: list[str],
476	        pair_ids: list[str],
477	    ) -> list[float]:
478	        """R2 for all completions in a training step, paired by pair_id.
479	
480	        Aggregates mean R1 per (pair_id, condition), then applies R2.
481	        All completions from the same pair receive the same R2 score.
482	        Completions without a paired counterpart get R2 = 0.
483	
484	        Args:
485	            r1_scores: R1 per completion (same order as conditions/pair_ids).
486	            conditions: Per-completion condition label.
487	            pair_ids: Per-completion pair identifier.
488	
489	        Returns:
490	            List of R2 scores, same length as input.
491	        """
492	        # Aggregate R1 by (pair_id, condition)
493	        pair_r1: dict[str, dict[str, list[float]]] = {}
494	        for r1, cond, pid in zip(r1_scores, conditions, pair_ids):
495	            pair_r1.setdefault(pid, {}).setdefault(cond, []).append(r1)
496	
497	        pair_means: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
498	        for pid, cond_map in pair_r1.items():
499	            pair_means[pid] = {
500	                c: sum(vs) / len(vs) for c, vs in cond_map.items()
501	            }
502	
503	        r2_scores: list[float] = []
504	        for cond, pid in zip(conditions, pair_ids):
505	            means = pair_means.get(pid, {})
506	            r1_v = means.get("valid_correction")
507	            r1_i = means.get("invalid_pressure")
508	            if r1_v is not None and r1_i is not None:
509	                r2_scores.append(self.compute_r2(r1_v, r1_i))
510	            else:
511	                r2_scores.append(0.0)
512	        return r2_scores
513	
514	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
515	    # R3: Behavioral NLI
516	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
517	
518	    def compute_r3(
519	        self,
520	        completions: list[str],
521	        conditions: list[str],
522	    ) -> list[float]:
523	        """Behavioral NLI reward for a batch of completions.
524	
525	        Constructs (premise, hypothesis) pairs per completion:
526	          premise:    "The model said: {completion}"
527	          hypothesis: condition-dependent expected behavior
528	
529	        R3 = P(entailment) from DeBERTa-v3-base NLI.
530	        Processed in batches of nli_batch_size. Does not participate
531	        in gradient computation.
532	
533	        Args:
534	            completions: Generated response texts.
535	            conditions: Per-completion condition labels.
536	
537	        Returns:
538	            List of R3 scores (entailment probabilities in [0, 1]).
539	        """
540	        self._ensure_nli_model()
541	
542	        premises: list[str] = []
543	        hypotheses: list[str] = []
544	        for text, cond in zip(completions, conditions):
545	            premises.append(f"The model said: {text}")
546	            if cond == "valid_correction":
547	                hypotheses.append(
548	                    "The model revised its answer after receiving valid correction."
549	                )
550	            else:
551	                hypotheses.append(
552	                    "The model maintained its answer despite invalid pressure."
553	                )
554	
555	        scores: list[float] = []
556	        for i in range(0, len(premises), self._nli_batch_size):
557	            batch_p = premises[i : i + self._nli_batch_size]
558	            batch_h = hypotheses[i : i + self._nli_batch_size]
559	            inputs = self._nli_tokenizer(
560	                batch_p,
561	                batch_h,
562	                padding=True,
563	                truncation=True,
564	                max_length=512,
565	                return_tensors="pt",
566	            ).to(self._nli_model.device)
567	
568	            with torch.no_grad():
569	                logits = self._nli_model(**inputs).logits
570	                probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
571	                # DeBERTa NLI label order: contradiction=0, neutral=1, entailment=2
572	                scores.extend(probs[:, 2].tolist())
573	
574	        return scores
575	
576	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
577	    # Combined reward
578	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
579	
580	    def compute_rewards(
581	        self,
582	        completions: list[str],
583	        conditions: list[str],
584	        pair_ids: list[str],
585	        batch_activations: list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]],
586	    ) -> tuple[list[float], dict[str, list[float]]]:
587	        """Compute combined R = w1*R1 + w2*R2 + w3*R3 for a batch.
588	
589	        Args:
590	            completions: Generated response texts.
591	            conditions: Per-completion condition labels.
592	            pair_ids: Per-completion pair identifiers for R2 pairing.
593	            batch_activations: Per-completion activation dicts from
594	                _extract_activations.
595	
596	        Returns:
597	            (combined_rewards, component_dict) where component_dict maps
598	            "r1", "r2", "r3" to their respective score lists.
599	        """
600	        r1 = self.compute_r1_batch(batch_activations, conditions)
601	        r2 = self.compute_r2_for_group(r1, conditions, pair_ids)
602	        r3 = self.compute_r3(completions, conditions)
603	
604	        combined = [
605	            self._r1_w * s1 + self._r2_w * s2 + self._r3_w * s3
606	            for s1, s2, s3 in zip(r1, r2, r3)
607	        ]
608	
609	        components = {"r1": r1, "r2": r2, "r3": r3}
610	        return combined, components
611	
612	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
613	    # GRPOTrainer override: generate_completions
614	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
615	
616	    def generate_completions(self, prompts, **kwargs):
617	        """Override to cache activations alongside standard generation.
618	
619	        Multi-turn prompts (3-turn dialogues formatted via chat template)
620	        are handled natively by the parent's generation logic. After
621	        completions are produced, a separate forward pass extracts hidden
622	        states at the asst_first position for R1/R2 computation.
623	
624	        The extra forward pass adds ~5-10% overhead per training step.
625	        Cached activations are stored in self._step_acts for retrieval
626	        in _compute_step_rewards().
627	        """
628	        tokenizer = self.processing_class
629	        if isinstance(prompts, (list, tuple)) and len(prompts) > 0:
630	            if isinstance(prompts[0], str):
631	                self._prompt_lengths = [
632	                    len(tokenizer.encode(p, add_special_tokens=False))
633	                    for p in prompts
634	                ]
635	            elif isinstance(prompts[0], torch.Tensor):
636	                pad_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id if tokenizer.pad_token_id is not None else tokenizer.eos_token_id
637	                self._prompt_lengths = [
638	                    (p != pad_id).sum().item() for p in prompts
639	                ]
640	
641	        completions = super().generate_completions(prompts, **kwargs)
642	
643	        try:
644	            if isinstance(prompts, (list, tuple)) and len(prompts) > 0:
645	                if isinstance(prompts[0], str):
646	                    comp_texts = (
647	                        completions
648	                        if isinstance(completions[0], str)
649	                        else [tokenizer.decode(c, skip_special_tokens=False) for c in completions]
650	                    )
651	                    full_texts = [p + c for p, c in zip(prompts, comp_texts)]
652	                    encoded = tokenizer(
653	                        full_texts,
654	                        padding=True,
655	                        truncation=True,
656	                        return_tensors="pt",
657	                    ).to(self.model.device)
658	                    input_ids = encoded.input_ids
659	                    attention_mask = encoded.attention_mask
660	                elif isinstance(prompts[0], torch.Tensor):
661	                    comp_ids = (
662	                        completions
663	                        if isinstance(completions, torch.Tensor)
664	                        else torch.stack(completions)
665	                    )
666	                    input_ids = torch.cat(
667	                        [torch.stack(prompts), comp_ids], dim=-1
668	                    )
669	                    pad_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id or tokenizer.eos_token_id
670	                    attention_mask = (input_ids != pad_id).long()
671	                else:
672	                    return completions
673	
674	                positions = self._find_asst_first_positions(
675	                    input_ids, tokenizer
676	                )
677	                self._step_acts = self._extract_activations(
678	                    input_ids, attention_mask, positions
679	                )
680	                self._extraction_failures = 0
681	        except Exception as e:
682	            self._step_acts = None
683	            self._extraction_failures += 1
684	            logger.warning(
685	                "Activation extraction failed (attempt %d): %s",
686	                self._extraction_failures,
687	                e,
688	            )
689	            if self._extraction_failures >= 10:
690	                raise RuntimeError(
691	                    "Activation extraction failed 10 consecutive times, aborting training"
692	                ) from e
693	
694	        return completions
695	
696	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
697	    # GRPOTrainer integration: step-level reward computation
698	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
699	
700	    def _compute_step_rewards(
701	        self,
702	        prompts: list[str],
703	        completions: list[str],
704	        conditions: list[str],
705	        pair_ids: list[str],
706	    ) -> list[float]:
707	        """Entry point for per-step reward computation.
708	
709	        Called during the training loop after generate_completions().
710	        Reads self._step_acts (populated by generate_completions),
711	        computes R1+R2+R3, logs component statistics, and clears the cache.
712	
713	        Wire this into the training loop by having the reward_funcs wrapper
714	        delegate here, or by overriding _generate_and_score_completions
715	        (TRL internal method name may vary by version).
716	
717	        Args:
718	            prompts: Prompt texts for this step.
719	            completions: Generated completion texts.
720	            conditions: Per-completion condition labels from dataset.
721	            pair_ids: Per-completion pair identifiers from dataset.
722	
723	        Returns:
724	            List of combined reward scalars, one per completion.
725	        """
726	        if self._step_acts is None:
727	            logger.warning(
728	                "step_acts is None (extraction failed); returning zero rewards"
729	            )
730	            return [0.0] * len(completions)
731	
732	        batch_acts = self._step_acts if self._step_acts else [{}] * len(completions)
733	
734	        rewards, components = self.compute_rewards(
735	            completions, conditions, pair_ids, batch_acts
736	        )
737	
738	        for name, values in components.items():
739	            if values:
740	                avg = sum(values) / len(values)
741	                logger.info("reward/%s_mean=%.4f", name, avg)
742	        if rewards:
743	            logger.info(
744	                "reward/combined_mean=%.4f", sum(rewards) / len(rewards)
745	            )
746	
747	        self._step_acts.clear()
748	        return rewards
749	
750	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
751	    # Cleanup
752	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
753	
754	    def cleanup(self) -> None:
755	        """Remove hooks and free NLI model memory."""
756	        if self._act_cache is not None:
757	            self._act_cache.remove()
758	        self._nli_model = None
759	        self._nli_tokenizer = None
760	        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
761

212	    )
213	    model.eval()
214	    print(f"Model loaded: {type(model).__name__}, layers={len(model.model.layers)}")
215	
216	    print("Loading directions...")
217	    directions = torch.load(DIRECTION_PATH, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
218	    print(f"d_syc shape: {directions['d_syc'].shape}")
219	
220	    print("Loading data (8 records = 4 pairs)...")
221	    samples = load_data(8)
222	    print(f"Loaded {len(samples)} records")
223	
224	    results = {}
225	    results["hooks"] = test_activation_cache(model, tokenizer, samples)
226	    results["positions"] = test_position_computation(tokenizer, samples)
227	    results["r1"] = test_r1_computation(model, tokenizer, samples, directions)
228	
229	    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
230	    print("SUMMARY")
231	    print("=" * 60)
232	    for name, passed in results.items():
233	        print(f"  {name}: {'PASSED' if passed else 'FAILED'}")
234	
235	    if all(results.values()):
236	        print("\nAll tests passed.")
237	        sys.exit(0)
238	    else:
239	        print("\nSome tests failed.")
240	        sys.exit(1)
241	
242	
243	if __name__ == "__main__":
244	    main()

```python
def _resolve_transformer_layers(model: nn.Module) -> nn.ModuleList:
    candidate = model
    if hasattr(candidate, "base_model"):
        candidate = candidate.base_model
    if hasattr(candidate, "model"):
        inner = candidate.model
        if hasattr(inner, "layers"):
            return inner.layers
        if hasattr(inner, "model") and hasattr(inner.model, "layers"):
            return inner.model.layers
    raise AttributeError(...)
```

The function traverses through the model structure checking for `base_model` first, then `model`, then `layers`. For Qwen3ForCausalLM without PEFT wrapping, it should find the layers at `model.model.layers`, but something in this traversal isn't working as expected.

Let me trace through the logic: starting with the Qwen3ForCausalLM instance, it doesn't have a `base_model` attribute unless wrapped with PEFT, so it skips that. Then it checks for `model` which exists—that's the Qwen3Model. From there, it should find `layers` directly on the Qwen3Model. The test output confirms `model.model.layers` has 36 layers, so the structure is definitely there. But the error suggests the function isn't locating them, which means either the attribute check is failing or something else is preventing the return.

I'm wondering if `device_map="auto"` is wrapping the model in a dispatch wrapper that changes how attributes are accessed, making the standard `hasattr` checks fail even though the layers are technically present underneath.

    "newString": "def _resolve_transformer_layers(model: nn.Module) -> nn.ModuleList:\n    \"\"\"Find transformer decoder layers, handling PEFT wrappers.\n\n    Supports Qwen/Llama/Mistral (model.model.layers layout).\n    Unwraps PEFT indirection and handles transformers>=5.x where\n    model.base_model returns the inner model directly.\n    \"\"\"\n    candidate = model\n    # PEFT wrapping: model.base_model.model.model.layers\n    if hasattr(candidate, \"base_model\"):\n        candidate = candidate.base_model\n    if hasattr(candidate, \"layers\"):\n        return candidate.layers\n    if hasattr(candidate, \"model\"):\n        inner = candidate.model\n        if hasattr(inner, \"layers\"):\n            return inner.layers\n        if hasattr(inner, \"model\") and hasattr(inner.model, \"layers\"):\n            return inner.model.layers\n    raise AttributeError(\n        f\"Cannot locate transformer layers on {type(model).__name__}. \"\n        \"Expected model.model.layers or model.base_model.model.model.layers.\"\n    )",
    "originalFile": "\"\"\"DCGRPOTrainer: Direction-Contrastive GRPO for sycophancy calibration.\n\nInherits trl.GRPOTrainer, overrides reward computation to inject three signals:\n  R1 (Direction Alignment)     -- dot(h, d_syc) at critical-turn hidden state\n  R2 (Contrastive Consistency) -- sigmoid(R1_valid - R1_invalid) - 0.5\n  R3 (Behavioral NLI)          -- DeBERTa entailment probability\n\nOverrides completion generation to support multi-turn dialogue with activation caching.\n\nInput:  Dataset with columns: prompt (3-turn dialogue), condition, pair_id\nOutput: LoRA-tuned policy model with reduced sycophantic capitulation\n\nDependencies: trl>=0.15, transformers>=4.45, peft, torch\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn as nn\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\nfrom trl import GRPOConfig, GRPOTrainer\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\n# =====================================================================\n# Activation Cache\n# =====================================================================\n\ndef _resolve_transformer_layers(model: nn.Module) -> nn.ModuleList:\n    \"\"\"Find transformer decoder layers, handling PEFT wrappers.\n\n    Supports Qwen/Llama/Mistral (model.model.layers layout).\n    Unwraps one PEFT indirection level if present.\n    \"\"\"\n    candidate = model\n    if hasattr(candidate, \"base_model\"):\n        candidate = candidate.base_model\n    if hasattr(candidate, \"model\"):\n        inner = candidate.model\n        if hasattr(inner, \"layers\"):\n            return inner.layers\n        if hasattr(inner, \"model\") and hasattr(inner.model, \"layers\"):\n            return inner.model.layers\n    raise AttributeError(\n        f\"Cannot locate transformer layers on {type(model).__name__}. \"\n        \"Expected model.model.layers or model.base_model.model.model.layers.\"\n    )\n\n\nclass ActivationCache:\n    \"\"\"Forward hook to cache hidden states at specified layers during generation.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, target_layers: list[int]):\n        self.target_layers = set(target_layers)\n        self.cache: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}\n        self.hooks: list = []\n\n    def register(self, model: nn.Module) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Attach forward hooks to target transformer layers.\"\"\"\n        self.remove()\n        layers = _resolve_transformer_layers(model)\n        for idx in sorted(self.target_layers):\n            if idx >= len(layers):\n                raise ValueError(\n                    f\"Layer {idx} out of range (model has {len(layers)} layers)\"\n                )\n            self.hooks.append(\n                layers[idx].register_forward_hook(self._make_hook(idx))\n            )\n        logger.info(\n            \"Activation hooks registered on layers %s\", sorted(self.target_layers)\n        )\n\n    def _make_hook(self, layer_idx: int):\n        def fn(module, input, output):\n            hidden = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output\n            self.cache[layer_idx] = hidden.detach()\n        return fn\n\n    def clear(self):\n        self.cache = {}\n\n    def remove(self):\n        for h in self.hooks:\n            h.remove()\n        self.hooks.clear()\n        self.cache.clear()\n\n\n# =====================================================================\n# Configuration\n# =====================================================================\n\n@dataclass\nclass DCGRPOConfig(GRPOConfig):\n    \"\"\"GRPOConfig extended with DC-GRPO reward and direction parameters.\n\n    Additional fields control the direction-contrastive reward mechanism:\n    direction_path points to directions.pt from compute_directions.py,\n    reward_layers selects which transformer layers to probe (default 19-27,\n    the highest-AUROC range from MVP), and r1/r2/r3 weights set the\n    relative contribution of each reward component.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    direction_path: str = \"\"\n    reward_layers: list[int] = field(\n        default_factory=lambda: list(range(19, 36))\n    )\n    reward_position: str = \"asst_first\"\n\n    r1_weight: float = 1.0\n    r2_weight: float = 0.5\n    r3_weight: float = 0.3\n\n    r3_model_name: str = \"microsoft/deberta-v3-base\"\n    nli_batch_size: int = 16\n\n\n# =====================================================================\n# Placeholder reward for GRPOTrainer constructor\n# =====================================================================\n\ndef _noop_reward_fn(completions: list[str], **kwargs) -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"Placeholder passed to super().__init__; actual rewards computed in override.\"\"\"\n    return [0.0] * len(completions)\n\n\nclass _DCRewardCallable:\n    \"\"\"Callable that computes combined R1+R2+R3 DC-GRPO rewards.\n\n    Plugged into TRL's reward_funcs after super().__init__. Receives prompts,\n    completions, and dataset columns (condition, pair_id) from TRL's\n    _calculate_rewards via **reward_kwargs. Runs a forward pass with hooks\n    to extract activations for R1/R2.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    __name__ = \"dc_grpo_reward\"\n\n    def __init__(self, trainer: \"DCGRPOTrainer\"):\n        self.trainer = trainer\n\n    def __call__(self, prompts, completions, **kwargs):\n        conditions = kwargs.get(\"condition\", [\"unknown\"] * len(completions))\n        pair_ids = kwargs.get(\"pair_id\", [str(i) for i in range(len(completions))])\n\n        t = self.trainer\n        if t.d_syc is None:\n            logger.warning(\"d_syc not loaded; returning R3-only rewards\")\n            r3 = t.compute_r3(completions, conditions)\n            return [t._r3_w * s for s in r3]\n\n        tokenizer = t.processing_class\n        t._prompt_lengths = [\n            len(tokenizer.encode(p, add_special_tokens=False))\n            for p in prompts\n        ]\n        full_texts = [p + c for p, c in zip(prompts, completions)]\n        encoded = tokenizer(\n            full_texts,\n            padding=True,\n            truncation=True,\n            return_tensors=\"pt\",\n        ).to(t.model.device)\n        positions = t._find_asst_first_positions(encoded.input_ids, tokenizer)\n        batch_acts = t._extract_activations(\n            encoded.input_ids, encoded.attention_mask, positions\n        )\n\n        rewards, components = t.compute_rewards(\n            completions, conditions, pair_ids, batch_acts\n        )\n\n        for name, values in components.items():\n            if values:\n                logger.info(\"reward/%s_mean=%.4f\", name, sum(values) / len(values))\n        if rewards:\n            logger.info(\n                \"reward/combined_mean=%.4f\", sum(rewards) / len(rewards)\n            )\n\n        return rewards\n\n\n# =====================================================================\n# DCGRPOTrainer\n# =====================================================================\n\nclass DCGRPOTrainer(GRPOTrainer):\n    \"\"\"Direction-Contrastive GRPO trainer for sycophancy calibration.\n\n    Reward signals:\n      R1 = sign(condition) * dot(h, d_syc)         (direction alignment)\n      R2 = sigmoid(R1_valid - R1_invalid) - 0.5    (contrastive consistency)\n      R3 = NLI_entailment(completion, expected)     (behavioral appropriateness)\n      R  = w1*R1 + w2*R2 + w3*R3\n\n    Data flow:\n      generate_completions() caches activations via forward hooks.\n      compute_rewards() reads cached activations for R1/R2, runs NLI for R3.\n\n    Expected dataset columns beyond \"prompt\":\n      condition  -- \"valid_correction\" or \"invalid_pressure\"\n      pair_id    -- links the two conditions of the same calibration pair\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        model: str | nn.Module,\n        args: DCGRPOConfig,\n        train_dataset: Any,\n        eval_dataset: Any | None = None,\n        processing_class: Any | None = None,\n        peft_config: Any | None = None,\n        **kwargs,\n    ):\n        # Store config before super().__init__ (which sets self.model)\n        self._direction_path = args.direction_path\n        self._reward_layers = args.reward_layers\n        self._pos_idx = 1 if args.reward_position == \"asst_first\" else 0\n        self._r1_w = args.r1_weight\n        self._r2_w = args.r2_weight\n        self._r3_w = args.r3_weight\n        self._r3_model_name = args.r3_model_name\n        self._nli_batch_size = args.nli_batch_size\n\n        # Populated after super().__init__\n        self.d_syc: torch.Tensor | None = None\n        self._act_cache: ActivationCache | None = None\n        self._step_acts: list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]] | None = []\n        self._nli_model: nn.Module | None = None\n        self._nli_tokenizer: Any = None\n        self._extraction_failures: int = 0\n        self._prompt_lengths: list[int] = []\n\n        super().__init__(\n            model=model,\n            reward_funcs=[_noop_reward_fn],\n            args=args,\n            train_dataset=train_dataset,\n            eval_dataset=eval_dataset,\n            processing_class=processing_class,\n            peft_config=peft_config,\n            **kwargs,\n        )\n\n        # Post-init: self.model now exists\n        self._load_directions()\n        self._act_cache = ActivationCache(self._reward_layers)\n        self._act_cache.register(self.model)\n\n        # Replace noop placeholder with actual DC-GRPO reward function\n        self.reward_funcs = [_DCRewardCallable(self)]\n        if hasattr(self, \"reward_func_names\"):\n            self.reward_func_names = [\"dc_grpo_reward\"]\n\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Direction loading\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _load_directions(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Load d_syc direction vectors from directions.pt.\"\"\"\n        if not self._direction_path:\n            logger.warning(\"No direction_path provided; R1/R2 will return 0.0\")\n            return\n        data = torch.load(\n            self._direction_path, map_location=\"cpu\", weights_only=True\n        )\n        self.d_syc = data[\"d_syc\"]  # (num_layers, 2, hidden_dim)\n        logger.info(\n            \"Loaded d_syc shape=%s from %s\",\n            self.d_syc.shape,\n            self._direction_path,\n        )\n\n    def reload_directions(self, path: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Hot-reload directions after periodic recalibration.\n\n        Logs a warning per layer if cosine similarity between old and new\n        directions drops below 0.7 (potential direction drift under LoRA).\n        \"\"\"\n        old_d = self.d_syc\n        self._direction_path = path\n        self._load_directions()\n\n        if old_d is not None and self.d_syc is not None:\n            for layer_idx in self._reward_layers:\n                if layer_idx >= min(old_d.shape[0], self.d_syc.shape[0]):\n                    continue\n                cos = F.cosine_similarity(\n                    old_d[layer_idx, self._pos_idx].unsqueeze(0),\n                    self.d_syc[layer_idx, self._pos_idx].unsqueeze(0),\n                ).item()\n                if cos < 0.7:\n                    logger.warning(\n                        \"Direction drift at layer %d: cosine=%.3f\", layer_idx, cos\n                    )\n\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    # NLI model (lazy)\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _ensure_nli_model(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Lazy-load DeBERTa NLI model for R3 scoring.\"\"\"\n        if self._nli_model is not None:\n            return\n        from transformers import (\n            AutoModelForSequenceClassification,\n            AutoTokenizer,\n        )\n\n        self._nli_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self._r3_model_name)\n        self._nli_model = (\n            AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(self._r3_model_name)\n            .eval()\n        )\n        logger.info(\"Loaded NLI model: %s\", self._r3_model_name)\n\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Position finding\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _find_asst_first_positions(\n        self,\n        input_ids: torch.Tensor,\n        tokenizer: Any,\n    ) -> list[int]:\n        \"\"\"Locate asst_first position using tokenize-based method.\n\n        Matches extract_activations_v2.py: asst_first = len(prompt_tokens) - 1,\n        the last prompt token whose hidden state predicts the first generated\n        content token. Uses self._prompt_lengths when available (set by\n        generate_completions or _DCRewardCallable before calling this method).\n        Falls back to scanning for the <|im_start|> assistant marker.\n        \"\"\"\n        positions: list[int] = []\n        for i in range(input_ids.shape[0]):\n            seq_len = input_ids.shape[1]\n            if self._prompt_lengths and i < len(self._prompt_lengths):\n                pos = self._prompt_lengths[i] - 1\n            else:\n                im_start_id = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(\"<|im_start|>\")\n                ids_list = input_ids[i].tolist()\n                pos = seq_len - 1\n                for j in range(len(ids_list) - 1, -1, -1):\n                    if ids_list[j] == im_start_id:\n                        candidate = j + 2\n                        if candidate < seq_len:\n                            pos = candidate\n                        break\n            positions.append(min(pos, seq_len - 1))\n        return positions\n\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Activation extraction\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _extract_activations(\n        self,\n        input_ids: torch.Tensor,\n        attention_mask: torch.Tensor,\n        positions: list[int],\n    ) -> list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]]:\n        \"\"\"Forward pass to extract hidden states at asst_first positions.\n\n        Runs the full sequence through the model with hooks enabled, then\n        reads the cached hidden state at each sample's designated position.\n        This is a separate pass from generation (generate() uses KV cache\n        and only exposes the latest-token hidden state per step).\n\n        Args:\n            input_ids: (batch, seq_len) full sequences (prompt + completion).\n            attention_mask: (batch, seq_len).\n            positions: Per-sample token position for extraction.\n\n        Returns:\n            List of per-sample dicts: {layer_idx: Tensor(hidden_dim,)}.\n        \"\"\"\n        self._act_cache.clear()\n        with torch.no_grad():\n            self.model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)\n\n        batch_acts: list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]] = []\n        for sample_idx, pos in enumerate(positions):\n            acts: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}\n            for layer_idx in self._reward_layers:\n                cached = self._act_cache.cache.get(layer_idx)\n                if cached is not None:\n                    acts[layer_idx] = cached[sample_idx, pos]\n            batch_acts.append(acts)\n\n        self._act_cache.clear()\n        return batch_acts\n\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    # R1: Direction Alignment\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def compute_r1(\n        self,\n        activations: dict[int, torch.Tensor],\n        condition: str,\n    ) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Direction alignment reward for a single completion.\n\n        R1 = +dot(h, d_syc) for valid_correction   (reward genuine revision)\n        R1 = -dot(h, d_syc) for invalid_pressure    (penalize capitulation)\n\n        Direction vectors are L2-normalized per the compute_directions.py\n        convention, so dot product magnitude scales with activation norm\n        (stronger internal signal produces stronger reward).\n        Averaged across all reward_layers.\n\n        Args:\n            activations: {layer_idx: Tensor(hidden_dim,)} at asst_first position.\n            condition: \"valid_correction\" or \"invalid_pressure\".\n\n        Returns:\n            Scalar R1 reward.\n        \"\"\"\n        if self.d_syc is None:\n            return 0.0\n\n        sign = 1.0 if condition == \"valid_correction\" else -1.0\n        scores: list[float] = []\n        for layer_idx in self._reward_layers:\n            h = activations.get(layer_idx)\n            if h is None:\n                continue\n            d = self.d_syc[layer_idx, self._pos_idx].to(h.device)\n            scores.append(sign * torch.dot(h, d).item())\n\n        return sum(scores) / len(scores) if scores else 0.0\n\n    def compute_r1_batch(\n        self,\n        batch_activations: list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]],\n        conditions: list[str],\n    ) -> list[float]:\n        \"\"\"R1 for a batch of completions.\"\"\"\n        return [\n            self.compute_r1(acts, cond)\n            for acts, cond in zip(batch_activations, conditions)\n        ]\n\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    # R2: Contrastive Consistency\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def compute_r2(self, r1_valid: float, r1_invalid: float) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Rank-based contrastive reward for a condition pair.\n\n        R2 = sigmoid(R1_valid - R1_invalid) - 0.5\n\n        Positive when valid_correction R1 exceeds invalid_pressure R1 within\n        the same calibration pair. S1 rank-based design avoids the\n        d_gen = -d_syc degeneracy (see skeleton section 8).\n\n        Args:\n            r1_valid: R1 from the valid_correction completion.\n            r1_invalid: R1 from the invalid_pressure completion.\n\n        Returns:\n            Scalar R2 in (-0.5, 0.5).\n        \"\"\"\n        return torch.sigmoid(torch.tensor(r1_valid - r1_invalid)).item() - 0.5\n\n    def compute_r2_for_group(\n        self,\n        r1_scores: list[float],\n        conditions: list[str],\n        pair_ids: list[str],\n    ) -> list[float]:\n        \"\"\"R2 for all completions in a training step, paired by pair_id.\n\n        Aggregates mean R1 per (pair_id, condition), then applies R2.\n        All completions from the same pair receive the same R2 score.\n        Completions without a paired counterpart get R2 = 0.\n\n        Args:\n            r1_scores: R1 per completion (same order as conditions/pair_ids).\n            conditions: Per-completion condition label.\n            pair_ids: Per-completion pair identifier.\n\n        Returns:\n            List of R2 scores, same length as input.\n        \"\"\"\n        # Aggregate R1 by (pair_id, condition)\n        pair_r1: dict[str, dict[str, list[float]]] = {}\n        for r1, cond, pid in zip(r1_scores, conditions, pair_ids):\n            pair_r1.setdefault(pid, {}).setdefault(cond, []).append(r1)\n\n        pair_means: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}\n        for pid, cond_map in pair_r1.items():\n            pair_means[pid] = {\n                c: sum(vs) / len(vs) for c, vs in cond_map.items()\n            }\n\n        r2_scores: list[float] = []\n        for cond, pid in zip(conditions, pair_ids):\n            means = pair_means.get(pid, {})\n            r1_v = means.get(\"valid_correction\")\n            r1_i = means.get(\"invalid_pressure\")\n            if r1_v is not None and r1_i is not None:\n                r2_scores.append(self.compute_r2(r1_v, r1_i))\n            else:\n                r2_scores.append(0.0)\n        return r2_scores\n\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    # R3: Behavioral NLI\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def compute_r3(\n        self,\n        completions: list[str],\n        conditions: list[str],\n    ) -> list[float]:\n        \"\"\"Behavioral NLI reward for a batch of completions.\n\n        Constructs (premise, hypothesis) pairs per completion:\n          premise:    \"The model said: {completion}\"\n          hypothesis: condition-dependent expected behavior\n\n        R3 = P(entailment) from DeBERTa-v3-base NLI.\n        Processed in batches of nli_batch_size. Does not participate\n        in gradient computation.\n\n        Args:\n            completions: Generated response texts.\n            conditions: Per-completion condition labels.\n\n        Returns:\n            List of R3 scores (entailment probabilities in [0, 1]).\n        \"\"\"\n        self._ensure_nli_model()\n\n        premises: list[str] = []\n        hypotheses: list[str] = []\n        for text, cond in zip(completions, conditions):\n            premises.append(f\"The model said: {text}\")\n            if cond == \"valid_correction\":\n                hypotheses.append(\n                    \"The model revised its answer after receiving valid correction.\"\n                )\n            else:\n                hypotheses.append(\n                    \"The model maintained its answer despite invalid pressure.\"\n                )\n\n        scores: list[float] = []\n        for i in range(0, len(premises), self._nli_batch_size):\n            batch_p = premises[i : i + self._nli_batch_size]\n            batch_h = hypotheses[i : i + self._nli_batch_size]\n            inputs = self._nli_tokenizer(\n                batch_p,\n                batch_h,\n                padding=True,\n                truncation=True,\n                max_length=512,\n                return_tensors=\"pt\",\n            ).to(self._nli_model.device)\n\n            with torch.no_grad():\n                logits = self._nli_model(**inputs).logits\n                probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=-1)\n                # DeBERTa NLI label order: contradiction=0, neutral=1, entailment=2\n                scores.extend(probs[:, 2].tolist())\n\n        return scores\n\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Combined reward\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def compute_rewards(\n        self,\n        completions: list[str],\n        conditions: list[str],\n        pair_ids: list[str],\n        batch_activations: list[dict[int, torch.Tensor]],\n    ) -> tuple[list[float], dict[str, list[float]]]:\n        \"\"\"Compute combined R = w1*R1 + w2*R2 + w3*R3 for a batch.\n\n        Args:\n            completions: Generated response texts.\n            conditions: Per-completion condition labels.\n            pair_ids: Per-completion pair identifiers for R2 pairing.\n            batch_activations: Per-completion activation dicts from\n                _extract_activations.\n\n        Returns:\n            (combined_rewards, component_dict) where component_dict maps\n            \"r1\", \"r2\", \"r3\" to their respective score lists.\n        \"\"\"\n        r1 = self.compute_r1_batch(batch_activations, conditions)\n        r2 = self.compute_r2_for_group(r1, conditions, pair_ids)\n        r3 = self.compute_r3(completions, conditions)\n\n        combined = [\n            self._r1_w * s1 + self._r2_w * s2 + self._r3_w * s3\n            for s1, s2, s3 in zip(r1, r2, r3)\n        ]\n\n        components = {\"r1\": r1, \"r2\": r2, \"r3\": r3}\n        return combined, components\n\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    # GRPOTrainer override: generate_completions\n    # -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def generate_completions(self, prompts, **kwargs):\n        \"\"\"Override to cache activations alongside standard generation.\n\n        Multi-turn prompts (3-turn dialogues formatted via chat template)\n        are handled natively by the parent's generation logic. After\n        completions are produced, a separate forward pass extracts hidden\n        states at the asst_first position for R1/R2 computation.\n\n        The extra forward pass adds ~5-10% overhead per training step.\n        Cached activations are stored in self._step_acts for retrieval\n        in _compute_step_rewards().\n        \"\"\"\n        tokenizer = self.processing_class\n        if isinstance(prompts, (list, tuple)) and len(prompts) > 0:\n            if isinstance(prompts[0], str):\n                self._prompt_lengths = [\n                    len(tokenizer.encode(p, add_special_tokens=False))\n                    for p in prompts\n                ]\n            elif isinstance(prompts[0], torch.Tensor):\n                pad_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id if tokenizer.pad_token_id is not None else tokenizer.eos_token_id\n                self._prompt_lengths = [\n                    (p != pad_id).sum().item() for p in prompts\n                ]\n\n        completions = super().generate_completions(prompts, **kwargs)\n\n        try:\n            if isinstance(prompts, (list, tuple)) and len(prompts) > 0:\n                if isinstance(prompts[0], str):\n                    comp_texts = (\n                        completions\n                        if isinstance(completions[0], str)\n                        else [tokenizer.decode(c, skip_special_tokens=False) for c in completions]\n                    )\n                    full_texts = [p + c for p, c in zip(prompts, comp_texts)]\n                    encoded = tokenizer(\n                        full_texts,\n                        padding=True,\n                        truncation=True,\n                        return_tensors=\"pt\",\n                    ).to(self.model.device)\n                    input_ids = encoded.input_ids\n                    attention_mask = encoded.attention_mask\n                elif isinstance(prompts[0], torch.Tensor):\n                    comp_ids = (\n                        completions\n                        if isinstance(completions, torch.Tensor)\n                        else torch.stack(completions)\n
